svg.text: hi,j = d00, 27c…: excerpts (3 hex) for the figure. xxHash64 returns 64 bits (16 hex).

svg.text: Speed ~19 GB/s: a 64³ cube (256 KB) is hashed in ~15 µs (on an Intel i7-9700K processor under Ubuntu x64 20.04).
